Adam Arous.note: Arous stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Arous turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Adam Arous.noteZh: 最能体现Adem Arous特点的是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。这一点直接体现在他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ali Abdi.summary: Ali Abdi is a Tunisia left-back at Nice who gives the national team overlap timing, crossing quality, and wide defending.
Ali Abdi.note: Abdi's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. At another point in the move, he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Ali Abdi.noteZh: Ali Abdi最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Amine Ben Hmida.summary: Mohamed Amine Ben Hamida is a Tunisia left-back at Espérance de Tunis who gives the national team defensive width, left-footed balance, and tournament experience.
Amine Ben Hmida.note: The key to Ben Hamida is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. The next thing to watch is whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Amine Ben Hmida.noteZh: Mohamed Amine Ben Hamida的比赛建立在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段之上。首先看他如何提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。换到另一个阶段，要看他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Anis Slimane.summary: Anis Ben Slimane is a Tunisia attacking midfielder at Norwich City who gives the national team carrying power, between-lines receiving, and midfield height.
Anis Slimane.note: Ben Slimane stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Also look at how Ben Slimane waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Anis Slimane.noteZh: Anis Ben Slimane的比赛建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下之上。首先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个方面是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Aymen Dahmen.note: What separates Dahmen is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Dahmen keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. At another point, he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Aymen Dahmen.noteZh: Aymen Dahmen最鲜明的特点是危险出现前组织好队友。一个直接线索是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Dylan Bronn.note: Watch Bronn for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Also notice how Bronn slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Dylan Bronn.noteZh: 理解Dylan Bronn，要先看危险出现前组织好队友。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Elias Achouri.note: For Achouri, the foundation is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Look first at how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Beyond that, watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Elias Achouri.noteZh: 理解Elias Achouri，要先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Elias Saad.note: The key to Saad is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. A separate part of his game is how Saad draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Elias Saad.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度构成Elias Saad踢法的核心。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。除此之外，值得留意他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Ellyes Skhiri.note: For Skhiri, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Also watch how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Ellyes Skhiri.noteZh: 最能体现Ellyes Skhiri特点的是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。这一点直接体现在他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。除此之外，他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Firas Chaouat.note: Chaouat's signature is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Watch how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. He also protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Firas Chaouat.noteZh: Firas Chaouat的优势在于防线重组前制造干净射门。最直接的表现是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。另一个值得观察的细节是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Hannibal Mejbri.note: What separates Mejbri is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Mejbri angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. In another phase of play, he plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Hannibal Mejbri.noteZh: 理解Hannibal Mejbri，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Hazem Mastouri.note: Watch Mastouri for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. The clearest example is how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. A separate clue is how Mastouri arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Hazem Mastouri.noteZh: 看Hazem Mastouri的作用，关键是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Ismael Gharbi.note: What separates Gharbi is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Gharbi draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Also note how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Ismael Gharbi.noteZh: Ismaël Gharbi的优势在于比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。最直接的表现是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Khalil Ayari.note: Ayari's signature is explosive speed once open grass appears. Watch how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. For a wider read, also watch whether he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Khalil Ayari.noteZh: 看Khalil Ayari的作用，关键是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。想再多看一层，可以留意他是否会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.note: Mahmoud stands out for reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. A different detail is how Mahmoud uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mohamed Hadj Mahmoud.noteZh: 对抗后球权松动时的第一反应是理解Mohamed Belhadj Mahmoud踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Montassar Talbi.note: The key to Talbi is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. One more thing to notice is how Talbi moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Montassar Talbi.noteZh: Montassar Talbi的比赛建立在危险出现前组织好队友之上。首先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Mortadha Ben Ouanes.note: For Ben Ouanes, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also watch how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Mortadha Ben Ouanes.noteZh: Mortadha Ben Ouanes的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Mouhib Chamakh.summary: Abdelmouhib Chamakh is a Tunisia goalkeeper at Club Africain who gives the national team shot-stopping depth, height, and domestic title-winning rhythm.
Mouhib Chamakh.note: Watch Chamakh in two moments. First, check whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Then watch whether he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Mouhib Chamakh.noteZh: 观察Abdelmouhib Chamakh时，可以看两个时刻。先看他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。再看他是否会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Moutaz Neffati.note: The key to Neffati is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In another phase, Neffati turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Moutaz Neffati.noteZh: 看Moutaz Neffati的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Omar Rekik.note: Watch Rekik for dealing with aerial balls in his defensive area. The clearest example is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle. A separate question is whether Rekik waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Omar Rekik.noteZh: Omar Rekik的优势在于处理防守区域内的高空球。最直接的表现是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Raed Chikhaoui.summary: Raed Chikhaoui is a Tunisia centre-back at US Monastir who gives the national team size, aerial defending, and fresh back-line depth.
Raed Chikhaoui.note: For Chikhaoui, the foundation is dealing with aerial balls in his defensive area. Look first at how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle. For a wider picture, notice whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Raed Chikhaoui.noteZh: Raed Chikhaoui的优势在于处理防守区域内的高空球。最直接的表现是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。想看得更完整，还要观察他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Rani Khedira.note: Watch Khedira for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate clue is how Khedira uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Rani Khedira.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解Rani Khedira踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Rayan Elloumi.note: What separates Elloumi is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Elloumi arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate detail appears when he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Rayan Elloumi.noteZh: Rayan Elloumi的比赛建立在等防守者注意力转移后再启动之上。首先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个方面是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Sabri Ben Hessen.note: Ben Hessen stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. A different question is whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Sabri Ben Hessen.noteZh: 理解Sabri Ben Hessen，要先看提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。下一个值得观察的问题是，他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Sebastian Tounekti.note: Tounekti's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. At another point in the move, he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Sebastian Tounekti.noteZh: 最能体现Sebastian Tounekti特点的是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。这一点直接体现在他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。除此之外，他也会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Yan Valery.note: The key to Valery is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. Elsewhere in the game, Valery takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Yan Valery.noteZh: 最能体现Yan Valery特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。
